content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to working with analog signals and [product_name]. I have a [product_name] with article number [article_no] and can't get the analog inputs to function. Do you have any advice or helpful links? Thanks in advance! The full article number is [article_no].
Hi [user_name], Have you checked this thread: [url] and this FAQ: Connecting a potentiometer to the integrated analog inputs on the [product_name] module? Best regards, [user_name]

Hello, If your product number is accurate, then this [product_name] model doesn't have analog inputs built-in. You should add an expansion module like [product_name] or swap your base module for one that includes analog inputs onboard. Hope that helps.
Thanks, [user_name]. The FAQ link looks promising for my needs—I'll give it a try this afternoon and will update you on the results.

Hi [user_name], Thank you for replying. On my [product_name] housing, it says: AC/DC 24V INPUT 8xAC/DC [product_name] 24RC. Is this really the only 24V version that doesn't support analog inputs? If so, which model should I get instead? Thanks in advance!

You need a 12/24 RC [product_name]. The power supply should be 12 or 24V DC. Only DC versions support analog inputs. You can also use an extension unit like [product_name], which also needs 24V DC power.
I see—my mistake! I must admit the product numbering is a bit confusing. Thank you all for your advice; I’ll try to exchange my unit.
